offering_description.value: Rents and sells downhole drilling tools, such as mud motors, drill collars and stabilizers, to oil and gas operators and drilling contractors. Delivers them from company yards and service centers in onshore US oilfields.

primary_products.value: downhole drilling motors; drill collars; stabilizers; drilling jars; fishing tools

primary_services.value: tool rental; drilling tool inspection and repair; on-site technical support

customer_segment.value: B2B: oil and gas exploration and production operators, drilling contractors

revenue_model.value: product sales: sales of drilling tools to operators and contractors; rental or leasing: rental of downhole tools for drilling jobs; service fees: tool inspection, repair and field support
revenue_model.category: product sales; rental or leasing; service fees

value_chain_position.value: service provider: provides tool rental and field services, sells to drilling operators and contractors; asset operator: owns and runs a rental fleet of downhole tools, takes in rental and service fees from drillers

geography_served.value: US national: onshore US oil and gas basins, including the Permian, Eagle Ford and Rockies

specialization.value: related lines: downhole motors, rental tools, jars and stabilizers for directional and horizontal wells

distribution_channels.value: own locations: company yards and service centers near oilfield basins; direct sales: sales made directly to operators and drilling contractors

regulatory_exposure.value: medium: oilfield safety, environmental and hazardous transport rules, no operating license required
